home.faq1A: We provide premium international network connectivity for cross-border business and AI use: e-commerce, overseas social media, cross-border data sync, and reliable access to AI services such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.
home.faq2Q: Which protocols and devices are supported?
home.faq2A: VLESS / VMess / Trojan / Shadowsocks are all supported and can be configured in common clients — copy your connection info and go.
home.faq3A: WeChat Pay, Alipay, card keys, and account balance. Service is activated instantly after payment.
home.faq4Q: How fast can I start using the service?
home.faq4A: Nodes are activated automatically within seconds of a successful payment; your connection info is provided immediately.
home.faq5Q: What if I run out of traffic?
home.faq5A: Renew or buy a new plan to top up duration and traffic. Expiry and traffic reminders are sent by email.
home.faq6A: Completed purchase orders can apply for a refund. Once approved, the amount is credited back to your account balance (usable for purchases or renewals; balance is non-withdrawable). Renewal and top-up orders are handled through customer service instead.
